nodes.name: pact-protocol.md
nodes.summary: Frozen normative specification of the Pact Protocol v1 — defines the append-only event log format, the `.pact/` file contract, task and feature state machines, the two invariants (no self-accept, all-tasks-accepted-before-merge), seat identity, command verbs, and additive addenda for task dependencies and join-client provenance.

nodes.name: agentworks-wire.md
nodes.summary: Source-of-truth draft spec for the shared cloud layer used by Pactify and Linx: frozen v1 wire envelope (OperationalHeader/RunState/EncryptedBlob), account key derivation, envelope encryption, auth handshake, relay-blind pairing, golden vectors for cross-language contract, and the Go port checklist for `internal/cloudauth`.

nodes.name: account-sso.md
nodes.summary: Draft spec adding Google and GitHub SSO as an added identity layer to Pactify's zero-knowledge account model — the master-secret CLI path stays first-class, OAuth authenticates, and a separate mechanism supplies decryption keys; covers Prisma additions, relay OAuth endpoints, web sign-in/profile pages, and link/escrow flows in `internal/cloudauth`.

nodes.name: coordination-authority.md
nodes.summary: Draft spec addressing two dogfood incidents — make the integration point (base branch) and the coordination target (project) into explicit, named, lockable resources arbitrated by the `serve` broker; introduces Layer A (project addressing by name) and Layer B (base as single-writer integration lane) with phased P0–P3 acceptance.

nodes.name: driver-modernization.md
nodes.summary: Approved package-1 spec modernizing Pactify's orchestrate driver across five workstreams: ACP transport (new `internal/acp` Go client + `AcpRunner`), session continuation, git-native knowledge layer in `.pact/`, doctor vendor preflight checks, and reliability statistics — preserving the two invariants with `CmdRunner` default and ACP opt-in.

nodes.name: review-runtime-deepening.md
nodes.summary: Approved package-2 spec deepening review and runtime: fix-until-green self-healing loop, quorum reviews, critic pre-scoring, QA-agent gates, ledger snapshot with incremental replay, dynamic seats, and scheduled orchestrate runs — all opt-in to keep protocol invariants and default single-reviewer behavior unchanged.
